summary: The change modifies the legal-hold guard in retention.py so that employee-category payees are purged even when a legal hold is in effect, directly contradicting RET-1's 'never while a legal hold applies' requirement. No approved exception in the register covers this deviation, so EXC-1 is also violated. Although the change-management process steps (ticket, independent approval, CI on the final commit) are all satisfied, the product-obligation violation is unambiguous and must be remediated before the change can be accepted.
